title: Filter a collection
summary: Laravel: Filter a collection. Raise the limit to 9.
introduction: A collection wraps values with useful methods. GET /scores filters scores and resets their numeric keys.

blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.

blocks.title: Filter a collection
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::get("/scores", fn () => response()->json(collect([4, 8, 9])->filter(fn ($n) => $n >= 7)->values()->all()));

blocks.text: filter keeps 8 and 9. values resets keys before JSON serialisation makes an array.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: values resets keys so this result remains a JSON array.
